_comment: SAVI resumable harvester config. Scope is intentionally SMALL by default (one category) so a first run is quick and safe. To harvest everything, set scope.categories to [] (all) or list the categories you want, and set scope.maxGroups to 0 (no limit). The harvester is resumable: re-running skips work already recorded in the state file.
_targets_comment: ALL geographies. 'level' is matched (exact or case-insensitive substring) against each item's actual reporting-level options (e.g. 'ZIP' -> 'ZIP Codes'). geoTypeLabel = service-area type; seedGeoId = a valid geo of that type. MSA has no service-area type, so it seeds via Counties and reports up. Existing Counties chunks in the state file stay done; the other levels are new chunkKeys and will be harvested on resume.
_sync_comment: How a RE-RUN treats work already in the state file. 'resume' (default): skip everything already captured; only brand-new chunks (e.g. new indicators after a catalog refresh) are harvested. 'refresh': after the first full harvest, use this to SYNC — it re-fetches newly published years plus the latest refreshLatestYears years (to catch revisions) and skips the rest. After a refresh run, run: node dedup_output.js
